title: Distributed grouped HAVING post-merge
completes: grouped post-merge family (450/451 ORDER BY/LIMIT SUM/MIN/MAX; 459 COUNT/AVG; 452 HAVING all variants)

design.spec: GroupedPostMerge.having: Option<GroupedHaving> = AND of {col_index, op, literal}
design.apply_order: filter HAVING -> stable-sort ORDER BY -> offset/limit (SQL order)
design.null: NULL on either side of a comparison drops the row (SQL unknown != TRUE)
design.resolution: AND-tree of <output-col> <cmp> <literal>; OR/NOT/IN/BETWEEN/function/non-literal -> None -> 449 loud error
design.per_owner_sql: count/aggregate: strip nulls inner HAVING; avg: rewritten_sql never had HAVING
design.derive: 3 plan structs dropped Eq (serde_json::Value not Eq); PartialEq only

adversarial_review.workflow: 4-dimension find -> independent refute-by-default verify (6 agents, ~399k tokens)
adversarial_review.bug: HAVING reused ORDER BY positional resolver: a bare integer was misread as a 1-based positional column index (HAVING has no positional semantics) -> `HAVING 1 > 5` silently became `region > 5` (returns all groups); `HAVING 2 <= SUM` mis-resolved/over-rejected
adversarial_review.fix: resolve_grouped_having_comparison extracts the literal side first; resolve_grouped_having_column rejects bare literals (Value/UnaryOp-Minus) before delegating, so the positional branch never fires for HAVING. Constant-only predicates -> None -> 449. Regression tests added.
adversarial_review.post_fix_recheck: single focused adversarial verifier on the fixed resolver

new_or_extended_tests: execution::tests::group_aggregate_fanout_resolves_having (resolution, flip, small-literal-not-positional regression, ineligible incl. constant-only)
